evidence_class: Literature and metadata evidence, plus unpinned source reads, from a read-only sweep on 2026-09-24 (5 angles, 37 items; 5 survive, 24 contested, 8 killed). No native execution, no market data fetched and no outcome computed. Not a frozen protocol: no window named here may be read for outcomes until status is frozen under freeze_preconditions.

sweep_input.publication: private scratch input, not committed: its verifier notes contain host paths. The README and the catalog supplement carry its content.

relation_to_prior_protocols.mover-early-entry-v1-20260924: PR #162 (open). 0 of 768 rule-exits pass development; the holdout was not read. Reused by reference only, pinned to commit 92062e8: rules.py definitions (ref, price_at_t, dollar_volume_at_t, gain_at_t, official prices, split factor), quotes.py cost-sample method and evidence/cost-table-run-v1.json. v3 never modifies blueprints/us-equities/mover-early-entry/**.
relation_to_prior_protocols.mover-followup-v2-20260924: PR #162, commit 92062e8: no pass in families E (216), F (16) or P (12); no holdout read. Not reused.
relation_to_prior_protocols.catalyst-experiment-v1-20260920: Its lane timing (16:15 decision, 09:35 entry, +60 s minimum latency, 5-session and 60-minute horizons) and the catalyst.py Item 1.01 contract are reused by reference. Its 2021Q1 ETF control is permanently inspected and is never a holdout.
relation_to_prior_protocols.broad-universe-mover-v1-20260921: Different population (close >= $5, median dollar volume >= $20M). Its evaluated segments are named in exposure_registry.

question: Among US-equity extreme movers, which conditioning (MAX lottery demand, catalyst versus attention, overnight versus intraday leg, halt state, days-to-cover crowding) changes the sign or size of the cost-net forward return, and can broker-held exits match client-side exits at fewer API calls? Continuation is one tested outcome, not the premise.
direction: long only (a short side for the MAX-reversal prior is an open question; borrow, hard-to-borrow fees and SEC Rule 201 were not examined)

already_looked_at.what: mover-early-entry v1 and v2 development outcomes (1,012 rule-exits) on the +20% candidate universe; the v1 cost table's quote sample was drawn from these development sessions
mover-early-entry v1 and v2 validation outcomes

the reserved holdout of mover-early-entry v1/v2, unread by #162 and owned by it. It is also exposed at event level: extreme-gainer-audit computed T+1/T+5/T+20 forward returns for 957 package events from 2021 to September 2026. v3 excludes this window.

broad-universe-mover-v1: development 2017-2021, validation 2022-2023 and reserved 2024-01-01 to 2026-08-14 were evaluated for daily signals on the close >= $5, median dollar volume >= $20M universe, including +20% one-day labels. Only liquid names overlap with the v3 population.
historical-simulation: six LEAN margin-stress scenarios on bundled SPY history; no mover-population outcome
LEAN/AAPL 2020, FB/META 2022, SPY parity and corporate-action diagnostics; engine and data checks, not mover outcomes

exposure_registry.draft_author_exposure: Before this draft the author read: #162's README results and v1 dev/val summary aggregates (per-rule means; P5/P95 of the 07:00|G0.20|V1000000 rule-exits, used only for sigma planning below); the v1 cost-table cells; the #162 review findings; the broad-universe README headlines; the sweep. No 2017-2020 mover-population outcome, and no halt, short-interest or MAX statistic for any window, has been computed or seen.
exposure_registry.update_rule: Every later read of data in any v3 window, before the freeze, is appended here with its date and purpose. A read of outcomes in a v3 validation or holdout window before the freeze voids that window.

populations.D_daily: symbol-sessions t with split-consistent official-close gain close[t]/ref - 1 >= 0.20, official close >= $1.00 and completed regular-session dollar volume >= $1,000,000; decision at 16:15 ET on t; entry at the first eligible quote at or after 09:35 ET on t+1 and at or after decision + 60 s; entry timeout 300 s, else no entry (counted)
populations.I_intraday: the first minute m in 09:35-10:30 ET on a session at which gain_at_t >= 0.20, dollar_volume_at_t >= $1,000,000 and price_at_t >= $1.00 (rules.py definitions at 92062e8); entry at the first eligible quote at or after m + 60 s; timeout 60 s
populations.exclusions: OTC; warrants, units and rights by #162's regex; a known halt at decision time blocks entry (as catalyst-experiment); symbols with fewer than 21 prior sessions of bars
populations.parameter_provenance: G = 0.20 and V = $1M are v1's loosest gain and middle volume floor, fixed for sample size after v1's all-negative dev/val grid was seen (disclosed exposure). They are not tuned on any v3 window.

holdout.window: the first 252 full NYSE sessions strictly after the session in which the frozen protocol commit is pushed
holdout.extension: if any holdout-eligible item has fewer than its minimum holdout trades, extend in 63-session blocks, at most 2, decided on trade counts alone with outcome labels uncomputed
holdout.why_prospective: No retrospective window disjoint from v1/v2 remains: 2021-2025 is v1/v2 dev/val, 2026-01-02 to 2026-09-18 is #162's reserved holdout and is event-level exposed, and 2016 is warm-up.

labels.development: disjoint from v1/v2; overlaps broad-universe development for liquid names; survivorship-limited before 2020 (names delisted in 2016-2019 without a retained corporate action cannot be discovered)
labels.validation: disjoint from v1/v2; overlaps broad-universe development for liquid names; the 2020 COVID regime is reported separately and never dropped

chronology.boundaries: Segments are assigned by entry session. A trade whose exit crosses a segment end is censored and counted. Multi-session arms leave a 6-session gap at each boundary.

H1.name: MAX/lottery conditioning of mover outcomes

evidence.source: Bali, Cakici, Whitelaw (2011) JFE 99(2), https://pages.stern.nyu.edu/~rwhitela/papers/max%20jfe.pdf; NBER w14804
catalyst-experiment/protocol.json ranks by relative_volume then price_return, a MAX-like selection

H1.covariate: MAX21 = the largest split-consistent daily close-to-close return over the 21 sessions ending t-1 (D) or the previous session (I), from data known at the decision; terciles within each decision date (ties by symbol)

exit_arms.a_fast: first eligible quote at or after min(entry + 30 min, 15:55 ET)
exit_arms.b_lane: D: first eligible quote at or after 15:55 ET on the 5th holding session (entry session = 1); I: at or after min(entry + 60 min, 15:55)
exit_arms.c_session: first eligible quote at or after 15:55 ET on the entry session

H1.stops: none beyond the engine margin rule

primary_tests.statistic: mean net(b_lane | high MAX tercile) - mean net(b_lane | low MAX tercile), population D

H1.tradable_cells: 2 populations x 3 arms x 3 terciles = 18; each tested for mean net > 0
H1.falsifier: Falsified if H1-D and H1-I both fail the corrected level, or if no tradable cell passes development. A significant high-MAX outperformance rejects the reversal prior.
H1.data_status: available now (Alpaca SIP daily and minute bars, official prices)

H2.name: Catalyst-verified movers versus pure attention spikes

evidence.source: Barber & Odean (2008) RFS 21(2); Barber, Huang, Odean, Schwarz (2022) JF doi 10.1111/jofi.13183; Barber, Lin, Odean (2023) JFQA
evidence.status: contested: refutation concerned a citation and the fit, not the direction; used as a prior on retail P&L only

H2.split: catalyst: an 8-K with Item 1.01 whose EDGAR acceptance time precedes the decision and falls after the previous regular close (D) or within the prior 3 sessions (I), per catalyst.py; attention: no qualifying filing. As-known identities only; an unparsed filing is unknown, reported apart and excluded from both groups.

primary_tests.statistic: mean net(catalyst) - mean net(attention), population D

H2.falsifier: Falsified if H2-D and H2-I both fail the corrected level, or both groups fail development: the catalyst filter adds nothing beyond the volume filter.
H2.data_status: available now (SEC EDGAR, public domain, 10 req/s, existing recipes; Alpaca SIP)

H3.name: Overnight versus intraday legs of mover holds

evidence.source: Lou, Polk, Skouras (2019) 'A Tug of War: Overnight Versus Intraday Expected Returns', JFE; Akbas, Boehmer, Jiang, Koch (2022) JFE
evidence.status: contested: original citation was a secondary summary; substance not refuted; DOIs unverified; large, liquid names

evidence.source: Maroy, SSRN 5095349 (posted 2025-01-12), VWAP and ladder exits
evidence.status: contested: HTTP 403, not read; excluded from the confirmatory family

exit_arms.a_intraday: enter at the first eligible quote at or after 09:35 on t+1; exit at or after 15:55 the same session
exit_arms.b_overnight: enter at the first eligible quote at or after 15:55 on t+1; exit at the first eligible quote at or after 09:30 on t+2
exit_arms.c_decomposition: diagnostic only, not traded: the 5-session b_lane hold split into overnight (prior 15:55 to next open) and intraday (open to 15:55) legs

H3.sizing: 1x; arm b stays at 1x in any later paper use until leverage-ladder-2x and its overnight cap are clean

primary_tests.statistic: mean over trades of (sum of overnight leg returns - sum of intraday leg returns) within the 5-session hold, gross

H3.tradable_cells: H3-a and H3-b are the tradable cells (counted once)
H3.falsifier: Falsified if H3-c fails the corrected level, or neither H3-a nor H3-b passes after costs.
H3.data_status: available now (Alpaca SIP minute bars with session open and prior close)

H4.name: Halt-conditional exit around LULD pauses

evidence.source: SEC DERA LULD white papers, https://www.sec.gov/files/dera-luld-white-paper.pdf and https://www.sec.gov/files/marketstructure/research/dera_wp_luld_and_extraordinary_transitory_volatility.pdf
evidence.status: contested: the execution-state idea survives; the pause-duration claim is a literature-review statement, not a DERA finding

evidence.source: Nasdaq 'All About LULDs' and the NasdaqTrader LULD FAQ (15 s limit state, 5-minute pause, last-10-minute pauses fold into the close)
evidence.status: contested: opened by the reviewer; band tiers must be checked against the current plan text before any hardcoding

H4.population: every trade of the H1-H3 traded arms whose security enters an LULD limit state or trading pause between entry and exit. The sweep conditioned this on passing arms; v3 uses all traded-arm trades, so a no-pass outcome still leaves a sample.

exit_arms.a_reopen: exit at the reopening-auction print, else the first eligible post-reopen quote
exit_arms.b_ignore: hold to the parent arm's exit, ignoring the halt

H4.rules: No fills during a halt; a resting stop fills through the gap at the first print. Pause duration is logged as a covariate only.

primary_tests.statistic: mean over halted trades of net(a_reopen) - net(b_ignore)

H4.falsifier: Falsified if H4 fails the corrected level or a stage has fewer than its minimum halted trades; the halt state then stays a safety rule only.
H4.data_status: gated: Databento XNAS.ITCH status schema (paid, metered; Nasdaq-listed only; cost and coverage start unverified), or Nasdaq Trader halt history (free, limited lookback, pilot only). Whether SIP conditions can rebuild halts is unverified.
H4.chronology: common, restricted to the halt source's covered listings and sessions as established by metadata before any outcome. A Nasdaq Trader pilot is exploratory and cannot pass. If the covered development span is shorter than 1 year, H4 is not tested and scores p = 1 in the family.

H5.name: Days-to-cover crowding overlay

evidence.source: Hong, Li, Ni, Scheinkman, Yan, 'Days to Cover and Stock Returns', NBER w21166, SSRN 10.2139/ssrn.2568768
evidence.status: survives: high DTC predicts lower returns

evidence.source: blueprints/us-equities/acceptance-wave/factors-regimes.md: FINRA consolidatedShortInterest is not a realtime squeeze signal

H5.covariate: DTC = the most recent FINRA short interest published before the decision (publication and settlement lag respected) / 20-session median share volume ending t; terciles within each decision date
H5.sizing: 1x; the overlay filters and never sizes

primary_tests.statistic: mean net(high DTC) - mean net(low DTC)
mean net(high DTC) - mean net(middle and low DTC pooled)

H5.falsifier: H5-p is falsified if the difference is not negative at the corrected level; H5-s if the high-DTC tercile does not beat the rest.
H5.data_status: gated on FINRA short-interest access and terms, which the user must establish; bi-monthly, an overlay only
H5.chronology: common, restricted to sessions whose decision has a published figure. If published history does not cover at least 1 development year and the whole validation year, H5 is not tested and both tests score p = 1.

H6.name: Execution parity: broker-held exits versus client-side ratchet (engineering, not alpha)

evidence.source: https://docs.alpaca.markets/docs/orders-at-alpaca (trailing_stop with trail_price or trail_percent; OCO; bracket; OTO)
evidence.status: trailing_stop survives; bracket contested and corrected to OCO for a held position

evidence.source: native_adapter.py builds only LIMIT/DAY orders; native_strategy.replace_exit cancels and resubmits when the price basis moves

H6.population: positions opened in Alpaca paper by the paper candidate (mechanics-only unless a v3 rule has passed its holdout), after the OCO and trailing_stop adapter paths exist. Each position's arm is the parity of the first byte of sha256(client_order_id). No order is created for the test itself.

exit_arms.a_client: the current exits.py chain with cancel-then-new replacement
exit_arms.b_broker: trailing_stop with trail_percent = effective_trailing_bps at entry / 100, plus an OCO for the stop and take-profit legs; time, risk-off, force and halt exits stay client-side

H6.shadow: for each position, the other arm's trigger time and reference price are computed from the same quote stream for paired diagnostics, never traded

primary_tests.statistic: median of (realized exit price - trigger reference) in bps, arm b minus arm a
log(mean REST calls per closed position, arm a / arm b)

H6.also_falsified_by: any paper partial-fill, trigger-price or trigger-reference behaviour that departs from the documented semantics (recorded per event)
H6.data_status: available now (Alpaca paper) once the adapter change lands; paper fills are simulated, so this is sim-to-paper evidence, not market evidence

chronology.note: prospective paper only; disjoint from every historical window

multiple_testing.family: one family across H1-H6: the 10 non-tradable primary tests (H1-D, H1-I, H2-D, H2-I, H3-c, H4, H5-p, H5-s, H6-e, H6-c) plus the 27 tradable cells (H1 18, H2 4, H3 2, H5 3), m = 37
multiple_testing.procedure: Holm step-down at family-wise alpha 0.05, applied separately at validation and at the holdout. An item not carried to a stage scores p = 1 there. Two-sided tests use 2 x min(one-sided p).
multiple_testing.development_screen: unadjusted p <= 0.05 in the stated direction, with the minimum sample; development only nominates items for validation
multiple_testing.lineage_sensitivity: The mover question has already tried 1,012 rule-exits (v1 768, v2 244) on other windows. Every validation and holdout p is also reported against Bonferroni 0.05 / (1012 + 37) = 4.77e-5. An item that passes Holm but not this level is labelled v3-family significant, lineage-unconfirmed.
multiple_testing.tests_not_in_family: BH (q = 0.10) diagnostics across tercile, year, price-tier and halt-covariate splits are reported but can never open the holdout

minimum_sample.rule: A stage below its minimum reports the item as underpowered; it cannot pass that stage.

minimum_detectable_effect.formula: MDE = (z(1 - 0.05/37) + z(0.80)) x sigma x sqrt(DEFF / n) for one cell; x sqrt(2) for a two-group difference with n per group
minimum_detectable_effect.sigma_provenance: 0.10 and 0.25 are (P95 - P5) / 3.29 from #162 v1 development aggregates (07:00|G0.20|V1000000 X2 and X1: P5 -15.0% / P95 +18.0%, and P5 -42.1% / P95 +39.5%); normal approximation, which understates fat tails. 0.35 is an assumption with no measured source. DEFF 1.5 for session clustering is an assumption.
minimum_detectable_effect.h6_equivalence: TOST margin 25 bps at the strictest family level (two one-sided tests at 0.05/37, a 1 - 2 x 0.00135 interval, z = 3.00); planning sigma of exit slippage 50 bps (assumption). At the 150-per-arm holdout the interval half-width is about 3.00 x 50 x sqrt(2/150) = 17 bps, so equivalence passes only if the observed difference is under about 8 bps; at 60 per arm the half-width (27 bps) exceeds the margin and no pass is possible
minimum_detectable_effect.reading: Only large effects can pass. A miss at these sizes is reported as underpowered for smaller effects, never as proof of no effect.

base_table.note: the same sha256 is recorded as inputs.cost_table_sha256 in #162's evidence/summary-dev-val-run-v1.json. Reused by reference; v3 refuses a table with another hash.

fix_1_monotone_dollar_volume.finding: #162 review item costs-F1: cells under $1M dollar volume fall back to a time x price pool that costs about half the $1-5M cell (for example 3|2|0 0.24% vs 3|2|1 0.75%)
fix_1_monotone_dollar_volume.rule: for each time x price bucket, hs'(>= $5M) = hs(>= $5M); hs'($1-5M) = max(hs($1-5M), hs'(>= $5M)); hs'(< $1M) = max(hs(< $1M), hs'($1-5M)). A less liquid tier is never cheaper than a more liquid one.

fix_2_impact_and_capacity.finding: #162 review item costs-F4: pass statistics use a fixed $20k notional with no impact term and assume full fills
fix_2_impact_and_capacity.notional: filled notional = min($20,000; 1% of the 20-session median dollar volume ending before the decision; 10% of the entry bar's dollar volume, or the opening auction's). The excess is not filled. A trade with filled notional under $1,000 is a no-fill and is counted.
fix_2_impact_and_capacity.impact: impact per side (return) = c x sigma_d x sqrt(q), where q = filled notional / 20-session median dollar volume and sigma_d = 20-session standard deviation of daily log returns, both known at the decision. Primary c = 1.0; sensitivities c = 0.5 and 2.0.
fix_2_impact_and_capacity.provenance: The square-root functional form and the c grid are design choices bracketing the unknown; the sweep supplies no source for them.

cost_model.out_of_period_spreads: The base table was measured on 2021-2023 quotes. Before the freeze, a 1-in-20 hash sample of development (2017-2019) entries is quoted with quotes.py's method at 92062e8; each cell's cost is then max(hs' from the base table, the 2017-2019 cell). Quotes are read at exit-agnostic timestamps only; no exit path is computed.
cost_model.per_side: 1.25 x hs' + impact, for continuous and auction sides alike (v1's 0.5x auction discount is not reused)
cost_model.fees: #162 fees.json (sha256 fa1f468b80f78dc0c050948123116f577e38ae9f8c03f9fb360d11042a3fed3d) by reference, extended before the freeze with SEC Section 31 and FINRA TAF rates in force during 2017-2020 from primary sources; Alpaca commission 0; IBKR tiered as a broker variant
cost_model.break_even: the cost multiple at which each cell's mean net return reaches 0 is reported

statistics.estimator: trade-level mean net return; also median, 1%-winsorised mean, mean without the top 5 sessions and mean of per-session means
statistics.bootstrap: circular session block bootstrap, B = 20,000; block length 5 sessions for same-session arms and 10 sessions for multi-session arms; difference tests resample sessions jointly for both groups; seed = the first 8 bytes of sha256(frozen protocol id), big-endian
statistics.p_value: one-sided p = (1 + #{b : stat_b on the null side of 0}) / (B + 1)
statistics.robustness_required_for_a_pass: a tradable cell's validation and holdout passes also need a positive winsorised mean, mean without the top 5 sessions and mean of per-session means

holdout_gate.opens_only_for: items that passed validation: a primary test or tradable cell with Holm-adjusted validation p <= 0.05 in the 37-item family, the minimum validation sample and, for a tradable cell, the robustness means. At most 5 tradable cells (lowest validation p) and every validated primary test.
holdout_gate.no_pass: If nothing validates, the holdout is never labelled or read, and that is the result.
holdout_gate.prospective_collection: Holdout-window data are collected forward into a sealed private snapshot whose sha256 is committed per collection batch. No outcome label, forward return or exit is computed from it before the gate opens.
evaluator_refusals: protocol status is not frozen, or its sha256 differs from the frozen commit
the validation results file is missing or its sha256 differs from the one committed
the list of validated items is empty
a requested item is not in that list
the access log has no committed 'granted' entry for this run
a previous holdout run exists (the holdout is read once; failed or partial runs stay in the log and are never called untouched)

access_log.mode: append-only JSON lines, committed and pushed before the read it authorizes
access_log.rule: Any holdout read without a preceding committed granted entry voids the holdout for every item. Refusals are logged too. Collection batches are logged with purpose 'collect' and rows_read 0.

leverage_and_exits: Research runs use 1x equal notional. Paper use of any passing rule follows the README's exit and leverage policy: broker-held OCO/trailing legs where the semantics fit, the leverage-schedule-v1-20260922 ceiling, and the leverage-ladder-1x/2x/4x gate rows in catalogs/us-equities/gates-20260922.json, one rung at a time with automatic step-down. The edge-shrink (fractional Kelly) term stays 0 until a holdout pass.
freeze_preconditions: An independent pre-outcome review of this draft from a different session and model family, with every finding resolved in a dated record
Direct reads of Lou-Polk-Skouras 2019, Akbas-Boehmer-Jiang-Koch 2022 and MacLean-Thorp-Ziemba 2010, or removal of every claim that depends on them
The 2017-2019 development cost sample fixed by rule and measured; fees extended to 2017-2020 from primary sources
Metadata-only coverage checks: the Databento get_cost quote and XNAS.ITCH coverage start (H4); FINRA short-interest history start and terms (H5). No outcome is computed.
Study code implementing this protocol committed with synthetic tests before any outcome, and the evaluator's holdout refusals tested
The exposure registry updated with everything the author saw since this draft
status set to frozen, frozen_before_outcomes true, and the protocol sha256 recorded in a pushed commit
overturn: Any headline result is overturned if a rerun on the same frozen inputs and runtime does not reproduce it byte for byte, if an independent quote sample puts the cost table off by more than 2x, or if the access log shows a holdout read that no committed granted entry preceded.
